question: Can bounded active-view recovery break repeated weak-RGB HOLD without losing full physical transport success or matched full-mission speed?
claim_scope: Local open-map nearby-pose RGB controller package only. Original spawn is observed development failure, not independent holdout. No isolated active-view causal effect, map generalization, statistical confirmation, or communication-efficacy claim.

comparison.same_runtime_for_both: standard scripts/open_simulation.command dispatch managed adapter; native realtime 1x; same 600-step solo RGB decision budget

fixed.camera: unchanged own RGB and common TOP RGB
fixed.student_input: own/TOP RGB, authored static map/goal, own issued commands only; no live GT joints, pose, contact or referee in control

diagnostic.source: candidate v43 both times; original spawn is the observed v40 development failure condition
diagnostic.purpose: Test full native recovery at the known v40 weak-RGB HOLD and decision-budget failure, not a new holdout.
must_pass_before_qualification: both raw/manager/launch/freeze/source hash and invariant audit valid
both RGB/typed lease/weld/camera/static-map/active-view boundary audit pass
each diagnostic contains at least one actually issued, audited active-view pose; otherwise it cannot establish weak-RGB recovery
diagnostic.failed_or_missing_diagnostic_policy: Stop before any nearby-pose qualification; preserve both planned diagnostics with started/failed/not-run denominators. Do not reinterpret postrun review of v40 as a passed gate.

qualification.failure_policy: Record every planned arm in order. Ordinary physical/protocol failure does not cancel later qualification arms if source/input/RGB/typed-lease/active-view/weld audit remains valid. Infrastructure collision, missing/corrupt evidence or source/input invariant failure stops subsequent launches; no replacement runs.

budget.budget_gate: Do not launch unless a full 370-second process allocation remains for that group. No overlap, retry, or automatic replenishment.
budget.solo_rgb_decision_rule: Use the existing frozen 600-decision guard; do not raise it to mask weak-RGB HOLD loops.

freeze_before_first_launch.rule: Root creates immutable freeze only after candidate candidate source/uniquely numbered bundle, exact CLI interface, run helper and postrun auditor are committed or SHA-pinned and clean. No pending fields at launch. Helpers verify pins before and after every trial. Source/helper changes require a new cohort.

host_ownership.prelaunch: Call frozen dddd67 host guard foreign_snapshot and classify_host_load(policy=strict) before every child; any foreign process including unknown cwd blocks, no teacher-data exemption.
host_ownership.during: Call frozen run_owned with host_load_policy=strict; monitor foreign_snapshot and clean only owned PGID on interference or timeout. Unknown cwd remains a blocker.
host_ownership.after: An infrastructure abort blocks the next scheduled trial. Never signal, stop, inspect UI of, or modify a foreign owner.

audit_contract.rule: A prelaunch fixture must cover nested pair RGB references, carry and rolling renewal kinds, unknown-kind rejection, and active-view issued-pose/zero-wheel/fresh-settled-RGB linkage. After each actual trial root creates a receipt by independent raw/manager audit. Missing or unsupported evidence is false, never inferred from result success. Runner cannot manufacture receipts.

active_view_evidence.required: Every accepted recovery pose must link to an actual issued own-robot pose command, zero-wheel hold for that pose, and subsequent settled fresh own/TOP RGB capture by frame/time and byte hashes; enforce bounded attempts, TTL and no GT/referee input. Mere planned poses, command windows, or success flags are insufficient.
active_view_evidence.negative_cases: Missing command, new wheel issue before fresh RGB, stale/unsettled capture on a claimed recovery, exceeded bound, ambiguous/missing stop or unknown receipt kind fail boundary. A recognized deadline/plan/permission or finite-policy refusal with complete cancellation/zero-wheel stop and no subsequent drive is an audited ordinary physical failure; it is not a recovery.
observables: weak RGB streak and HOLD count
saved_sources: solo-decisions.json view_recovery rows with anchor/current own/TOP RGB SHA and quality
solo-raw-actions.json exact zero-wheel port HOLD receipt and pose PWM issuance; issued-commands.json independently checks no newly issued wheel action
active_view_evidence.safe_abort: A pose interrupted by the finite deadline or plan/permission loss may end without settled RGB only if its submitted/raw PWM/cancellation or completion, exact zero-wheel stop, known reason and no later drive are all recorded. The stop deadline is measured from the episode's first issued pose, not its last. Recovered-drive resumption still requires post-pose settled fresh own/TOP RGB.
active_view_evidence.identity_scope: Bounded cargo identity is audited against saved own/TOP RGB frame hashes, tracker receipt, and frozen source behavior. The post-run auditor does not independently resegment JPEG pixels.

audit_contract.preflight_report_path: default /Users/changmin/projects/ugrp/outputs/act-action-training-20260924/view-recovery-audit-preflight.json; immutable numbered suffix allowed before freeze if a prior fixture report exists

directional_speed_gate.requires: All three matched nearby-pose pairs have reference and candidate physical_success+protocol_complete, complete boundary audits, unchanged scene/contact/weld and uncontended valid full-mission wall times.
directional_speed_gate.metric: Median candidate full-mission wall_s across the three cases <= 0.90 * median reference full-mission wall_s. Report each paired wall difference and relative reduction; no requirement that every candidate pair be faster.
directional_speed_gate.failure_handling: Failed/aborted/timing-excluded wall times are excluded from speed median but retained with denominator; an absent valid pair makes the gate false.
directional_speed_gate.claim: Directional local completion-time evidence only; three pairs are not statistical confirmation.

phase_and_timing_analysis.primary: Full physical mission completion wall_s, counted only for physical_success and protocol_complete with complete audits and uncontended timing; retain every planned arm in the denominator.
report_for_each_started_run: all other phase SIM seconds and total motion SIM seconds
full mission wall_s and motion_sim_to_wall ratio
host load or foreign-process evidence and timing exclusion reason
rolling command windows, issued-command count, observed motion, and carrier-relink evidence separately
weak-RGB streak length and HOLD count
active-view pose issue/zero-wheel/settled RGB counts and failure reasons
approach drive-window union (issued command, not measured travel)
phase_and_timing_analysis.interpretation: With overlap_start=grasp, approach savings can be absorbed by beam-grasp waiting. Source-level active-view microbenchmarks, fewer HOLDs, and issued approach windows are mechanism evidence only. Full physical transport success and full-mission wall time determine the physical claim; issued windows are not measured motion. Report SIM/wall and host load without an arbitrary 0.98 cutoff.
phase_and_timing_analysis.cohort_boundary: Do not pool v40 stopped diagnostic, synchronized Claude runs or other cohorts with native v43 paired trials.

output.every_trial: raw result/video, pair/solo RGB decisions, issued commands, manager manifest, immutable launch record, per-run audit receipt and source/config/model hashes
output.diagnostic: diagnostics excluded from qualification speed median
output.tensorboard: new native snapshot after completed evidence, including failures; preserve existing originals/snapshots

prior_result_boundary: v40 original/candidate-diagnostic-1 physically failed after 261.8897 s from solo RGB 600-decision exhaustion. Canonical audit invalid and frozen protocol stopped; diagnostic-2 and six qualification arms NOT RUN. Separate review of v40 audit schema cannot retroactively open that cohort. v28 successes do not transfer to v43.
